summary: Places bubbles on bars whose volume is at least twice the recent average, sized by how far above average they are.
overview: Volume Bubble / Big Prints puts a circle on bars with heavy volume, so they stand out. Up candles get a green bubble at the high and down candles a red bubble at the low. Larger bubbles mean volume further above average, and a label shows the multiple, such as 3.2x.
how: For each bar, volume is compared with the average of the previous 50 bars. Bars at or above 2 times average get a bubble. Bubble size grows with the multiple, between a minimum and maximum size you set. Up to 80 bubbles show on screen, keeping the biggest.
It uses the chart's own candle volume.
use: Some traders use it to spot high-volume bars at a glance.
Use it to see whether a breakout or reversal bar had unusual volume.
Some traders compare bubble bars with nearby levels.
notes: It marks whole bars, not single trades; for single orders see Big Trades.
